name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
who: Kisan parivar jinke naam kheti ki zameen hai (income tax dene wale, sarkari naukri wale, pensioner 10000+ ko chhodkar)
benefit: Saal mein 6000 rupaye, 2000-2000 ki 3 kisht seedha bank khate mein
docs: Aadhaar, zameen ke kagaz (khatauni), bank khata Aadhaar se juda
how: pmkisan.gov.in ya CSC centre, e-KYC zaroori

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
who: Garib aur kamzor parivar (SECC list / ration card ke hisaab se), aur 70 saal se upar ke sabhi buzurg
benefit: Parivar ko har saal 5 lakh tak ka muft ilaaj, sarkari aur jude hue private hospital mein
how: beneficiary.nha.gov.in, Ayushman app, ya CSC / hospital ke Ayushman Mitra se card banwayein

name: PM Awas Yojana Gramin
who: Gaon ke beghar ya kachche ghar wale parivar jo survey list mein hain
benefit: Pakka ghar banane ke liye maidani ilake mein lagbhag 1.2 lakh rupaye ki madad
how: Gram panchayat / block office se sampark

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
who: Garib parivar ki mahila (18+), jinke ghar pehle se LPG connection nahi
benefit: Muft LPG connection, pehla cylinder aur chulha, cylinder par subsidy

name: PM Jan Dhan Yojana
who: Koi bhi bharatiya jiska bank khata nahi hai
benefit: Zero balance khata, RuPay card, accident bima, overdraft suvidha
how: Kisi bhi bank branch ya bank mitra

name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
benefit: Kisi bhi karan maut par parivar ko 2 lakh, premium lagbhag 436 rupaye saal
how: Apne bank ya net banking se jud sakte hain

name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
benefit: Durghatna mein maut ya poori viklangta par 2 lakh, premium lagbhag 20 rupaye saal

name: Atal Pension Yojana
who: 18 se 40 saal ke log jo income tax nahi dete
benefit: 60 saal ke baad har mahine 1000 se 5000 tak pension, jitna jama karein us hisaab se

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
who: 10 saal se kam umar ki beti ke mata-pita
benefit: Beti ke naam bachat khata, achha byaaj, tax chhoot, padhai aur shaadi ke liye paisa
docs: Beti ka janm praman patra, mata-pita ka Aadhaar

name: PM Matru Vandana Yojana
who: Garbhvati aur doodh pilane wali mahilayein (pehla bachcha, aur doosra bachcha beti ho to)
benefit: Pehle bachche par 5000 rupaye, doosri beti par 6000 rupaye

name: Vriddha Pension (IGNOAPS)
who: 60 saal se upar, garibi rekha se neeche wale buzurg
benefit: Har mahine pension (kendra ka hissa + rajya ka hissa, rajya ke hisaab se alag)
docs: Aadhaar, umar praman, BPL / ration card, bank khata
how: Block office ya rajya ka social welfare portal

name: e-Shram Card
who: 16 se 59 saal ke asangathit mazdoor (rickshaw, rajmistri, ghar ka kaam, khet mazdoor) jo EPFO/ESIC mein nahi
benefit: Sarkari mazdoor pehchaan, 2 lakh ka accident bima, aage ki yojanaon ka fayda
docs: Aadhaar, Aadhaar se juda mobile, bank khata

name: PM SVANidhi
benefit: Bina guarantee loan: pehle 10000, time par chukane par 20000 aur phir 50000, digital lenden par cashback
docs: Aadhaar, vending certificate ya nagar nigam ki sifarish

name: PM Vishwakarma
who: Karigar jaise badhai, lohar, nai, darzi, kumhar, mochi, raj mistri (18+)
benefit: Training, 15000 tak ka toolkit, 5% byaaj par 3 lakh tak loan

name: Kisan Credit Card
who: Kisan, pashupalak aur machhli palan karne wale
benefit: Kheti ke liye sasta loan, samay par chukane par byaaj mein chhoot

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana
benefit: Baadh, sookha, keede se fasal kharab hone par bima ka paisa, kam premium
docs: Aadhaar, bank khata, zameen ya bataai ke kagaz, buwai praman
how: pmfby.gov.in, bank ya CSC, buwai ke samay tak
